entries.title: Start a backlog task from its row in the Tasks panel
entries.body: Rest the pointer on a task in the Tasks panel's backlog and a Start button appears at the row's end; one press starts the task, as Start on its record does. A task that could not start offers Try again. A task that cannot start yet shows Start dimmed, and resting on it says why. From the keyboard, press → on a backlog row to reach its Start, Enter to press it, and ← to go back.

picture.alt: The Tasks panel's backlog with the pointer resting on Chart the harbour, whose row shows a Start button at its right end
